title: Juicy Portuguese Tomato Casserole
description: A pungent and creamy Portuguese dish featuring tomato puree and soffritto base, perfect for a nostalgic meal. This ovo-vegetarian friendly recipe is cooked in a banana leaf vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onions until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, whisk together the tomato puree, eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked onion and garlic mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Spoon the mixture into the center of each banana leaf, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
If using cheese, sprinkle it on top of the mixture.
Fold the banana leaves over the filling to form a packet and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the packets from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
